title: Robust VLAN/QinQ Handling Across Network Interfaces
acceptance_criteria: Create flow supports standard VLAN (vif), QinQ service VLAN (vif-s), and QinQ customer VLAN (vif-c).
Edit flow applies the correct operation family for each VLAN type.
Delete flow is available from the interface UI for all VLAN types.
Nested vif-c entries are visible in the VLAN list and clearly labeled.
Backend supports delete_vif_s and delete_vif_c operations.
Malformed VLAN delete payloads return client validation errors (HTTP 400), not generic 500 errors.
Frontend build/runtime checks pass and services are restarted on :3000/:8000.
assumptions: Current router/mappers remain the source of truth for vif/vif-s/vif-c command semantics.
QinQ customer VLAN creation may auto-create missing service VLAN when selected.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host until OS dependencies are installed.

tasks.notes: Translated user request into concrete VLAN/QinQ acceptance criteria with backend and UI coverage.
Implemented `delete_vif_s`/`delete_vif_c` and fixed error propagation by re-raising HTTPException.
Implemented robust VLAN/QinQ create/edit/delete UX and added nested vif-c visibility.
Added targeted backend regression tests for new VLAN delete operations and invalid payload handling.
Ran backend pytest and frontend typecheck/build/lint/runtime smoke; restarted vm-api and vm-ui successfully.
